_comment: HAND-BUILT, unlike me.json which is a captured live CDS response. Every asset in the real capture carries a duration, so the untimed case — the one the drift mechanic exists for — does not occur in it. This document is the same shape as a real one, trimmed to the fields toWireItem() reads, with the duration removed from the audio asset and an mp3 enclosure that still carries its fileSize. 3360000 bytes / 16000 bytes-per-second = 210 seconds.

resources.title: A Chicago alderman wants the city's speed cameras switched off
resources.teaser: The ward has four of them, and the alderman says the tickets fall hardest on the people least able to pay.
